description: What the harness computes when an external optimiser (SIDERIUS) asks for the score of a candidate foundation model. 'trial' is the cheap development score, 'formal' the benchmark score. Values are frozen per benchmark version; the optimiser only chooses the candidate.
aggregate: mean of the primary metric over the datasets listed (a dataset whose primary metric is not estimable makes the aggregate null)

trial.note: linear probe on the 1 % regime, scored on the frozen coarse subset only (the test split is never touched in a trial)

formal.note: user decision 2026-10-23 (phase 1, 'frozen encoder only'): linear probe on the 10 % regime with the encoder frozen, scored on the test split; full fine-tuning and the scratch control are deferred to phase 2 (full-scale training of the selected recipe)
